{{Top|leg}}
'''Psychosis''' was a malady of the mental faculties suffered by multiple [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

[[Durge/Legends|Durge]] was known to suffer a variation known as [[cybernetic psychosis]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] would suffer from [[clone madness]], a precursor to psychosis. [[Entechment rig]]s could also drive a being to psychosis.
